name: self_heal_integration_lq1236_20261108
comment: LQ-20261107-1236: the self-heal fixer runs the integrated safety and metrics flow. The kill switch (a KILL file under the state root, the config flag or the SELF_HEAL_KILL env var) stops everything, dry runs included. The global daily cap across all lanes blocks an attempt before any budget is spent. Every job transition writes exactly one append-only metrics row, and an empty evidence pack is counted as insufficient_evidence. The agent's sanctioned NOT_CODE exit escalates the job to escalated_not_code and keeps none of its changes. The evidence pack is fenced in the prompt as untrusted data. Hermetic: tmp git repos, tmp state and a fake backend.
